How to Use Silence Timer

Quick Start: Tap the big play button in the center of your screen to start your first 25-minute Pomodoro timer!

1. Setting Up Your First Timer

Silence Timer is built around the idea of immediate action. On the Focus tab, you will see a large circular timer. To adjust the time, you can tap it, use the quick minute buttons that appear, or use the Quick Presets at the bottom of the screen.

2. Using Quick Presets

We've included several default presets like Deep Work (1.5 hrs), Meeting (1 hr), and Power Nap (20 min). Tapping any of these immediately starts a timer with those configurations.

You can edit these presets by tapping the "Edit" button above the preset grid. Here you can change their durations, colors, and icons to match your specific workflows!

3. Strict Silence Mode

This is where the magic happens. Notice the small switch below the top navigation tabs labeled "Silent Mode". Turning this ON before starting a timer will hook directly into Android's Do Not Disturb systems to ensure absolute zero distractions.

  • You will need to grant Do Not Disturb access permissions the first time you enable this.
  • When your timer ends, your phone will automatically return to its normal volume and notification settings.

4. Viewing Your Insights

As you complete focus sessions, data is populated in the Insights tab. Here you can track your Total Sessions, Total Focus Time, and your Current Streak. Over time, beautifully generated charts will show what days of the week you are most productive.
